## Core Positioning
- **Primary Track:** Cross-functional & Delivery Project Manager (B2B SaaS, MarTech, AI, Enterprise e-commerce, FinTech, EdTech). Scope decomposition, functional specifications, User Story Mapping, Discovery & Delivery (CJM, CustDev, RICE/ICE), A/B experimentation backed by unit economics, risk & SLA control.
- **Adjacent Strength:** Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager. Managing portfolios of 10–15 Enterprise accounts, executive QBRs with C-level stakeholders, NRR & retention (98.6% quarterly NRR), churn prevention, renewals, and module expansion.

## Selected Verified Impact (NDA-compliant)
- **Enterprise Fashion Retail (NDA):** 362M RUB incremental revenue in 3 months (25% Web, 26% App share, 246% ROI); Web-to-App migration campaign with 8,932 installs (25% CR, 1.5-year record); UTM performance pilot (+73% CR, -48% cost-to-revenue ratio).
- **Federal Omnichannel FMCG Retail (NDA · AI Ecom Awards 2026):** 95M RUB direct revenue in 4 months (>4x YoY mobile app growth, 248% ROI); AI experimentation portfolio (+24.7% revenue per session, +26.4% AOV, +15.3% purchase probability).
- **Major Pet Retail (NDA · Retail Rocket Group):** 6x turnaround of recommendation revenue to 56.2M RUB in H2 (38.3k orders); 16 automated trigger flows lifting channel conversion to 12.1%.
- **D2C E-commerce & Retail A/B Discipline (NDA):** 557% ROI within first 46 days (+57% daily revenue growth); unit-economics-driven A/B stop-calls and +18.1% mobile search Add-to-Cart uplift.
- **B2B SaaS, AI & International Delivery (Dbrain, MAG Development, Emerging Travel Group):** 20-step OCR + Anti-fraud + 4 CRM modules functional spec; 5-module quality claims system spec; English-language 1C Drive rollout for an Australian business unit; global travel-tech partnerships (Travelgate, Juniper, Atriis, GIATA, Vervotech).
